name: Avatares AI - Promote Canonical Asset - Callable

parameters.query:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM canonical_asset_registry
  WHERE asset_id = '{{ $json.assetId }}'
  LIMIT 1
), demoted AS (
  UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
  SET
    is_canonical = false,
    status = 'selected',
    metadata = jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(metadata, '{status}', '"selected"'),
        '{isCanonical}', 'false'
      ),
      '{reviewNotes}', '"Demoted by canonical promotion"'
    )
  WHERE canonical_group = (SELECT canonical_group FROM selected)
    AND is_canonical = true
    AND asset_id <> (SELECT asset_id FROM selected)
  RETURNING asset_id
), promoted AS (
  UPDATE canonical_asset_registry
  SET
    is_canonical = true,
    status = 'canonical',
    review_notes = 'Promoted to canonical',
    metadata = jsonb_set(
      jsonb_set(
        jsonb_set(
          jsonb_set(metadata, '{status}', '"canonical"'),
          '{isCanonical}', 'true'
        ),
        '{reviewNotes}', '"Promoted to canonical"'
      ),
      '{canonicalGroup}', to_jsonb((SELECT canonical_group FROM selected))
    )
  WHERE asset_id = (SELECT asset_id FROM selected)
  RETURNING
    asset_id,
    sha256,
    avatar,
    asset_type,
    scene,
    version,
    bucket,
    object_path,
    original_filename,
    mime_type,
    file_size,
    extension,
    status,
    is_canonical,
    canonical_group,
    metadata,
    created_at
)
SELECT
  promoted.*,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM demoted) AS demoted_count
FROM promoted;
